list.item: Exhaustion, broken sleep and low mood for about two months, under sustained threats and a punishing schedule, after an admission for exhaustion and a respiratory infection six months ago; cause not established at intake: a depressive disorder, an adjustment disorder, PTSD, an insomnia disorder, thyroid disease and anemia to be assessed; psychiatry consultation requested: active, confirmed [S]
Nicotine dependence, cigarettes: about a pack a day since his twenties, smoked out of public view: active, confirmed [S]
Elevated blood pressure readings in the clinic (138/88 mmHg) without a diagnosis of hypertension; home monitoring to confirm: active, confirmed [S]

Healed stab wound of the left chest, repaired by thoracotomy seven years ago; occasional aching along the scar with coughing and in cold weather, without exertional or ischemic features: active, confirmed [S]

Psychiatry consultation in two weeks to confirm the diagnosis, assess for PTSD and safety, and advise on therapy and medicine. Guideline: Clinical Practice Guideline for the Treatment of Depression Across Three Age Cohorts (2019); VA/DoD Clinical Practice Guideline for the Management of Posttraumatic Stress Disorder and Acute Stress Disorder (2023) [S]

Assessment at intake: blood count, metabolic panel, TSH, lipids, hemoglobin A1c and ECG; PHQ-9, GAD-7, PC-PTSD-5 and AUDIT-C; Insomnia Severity Index and sleep apnea screening; safety plan with the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline and the clinic number. Guideline: CMID: Clinical Monitoring Intelligence Database, depression, bipolar, and mood disorders, hypertension and hyperlipidemia monographs (2026); VA/DoD Clinical Practice Guideline for Assessment and Management of Patients at Risk for Suicide (2024); Management of Chronic Insomnia Disorder in Adults: A Clinical Practice Guideline From the American College of Physicians (2016) [S]

Tobacco: advice to quit, an offer of counseling and medicine, and a quit plan agreed by shared decision. Guideline: Tobacco Smoking Cessation in Adults, Including Pregnant Persons: Interventions (2021) [S]

Blood pressure: validated home monitoring, twice morning and evening for seven days, before a diagnosis is made. Guideline: CMID: Clinical Monitoring Intelligence Database, depression, bipolar, and mood disorders, hypertension and hyperlipidemia monographs (2026); 2017 ACC/AHA/AAPA/ABC/ACPM/AGS/APhA/ASH/ASPC/NMA/PCNA Guideline for the Prevention, Detection, Evaluation, and Management of High Blood Pressure in Adults (2017); Hypertension in Adults: Screening (2021) [S]

Privacy: a restricted chart with audited access, documentation kept to what care requires, and a choice of therapist, including a Black clinician if he prefers. Guideline: Clinical Practice Guideline for the Treatment of Depression Across Three Age Cohorts (2019) [S]
